# Contact support observations

`ContactSupportOracle.java` invokes original Java methods through reflection on real placed organisms.
It observes pre-contact effects, friendly effects, infectious-segment neutralization, and three lavender shield helpers.
It uses no Rust results or copied expected-result formulas.

The source runs twice. The original JAR runs separately.
All outputs and four compiled helper classes match.
The producer verifies 74 original artifact pins and 24 earlier TSV fixtures.
Six negative guards reject missing profile roots, missing arguments, and existing output directories.
The existing-output guard preserves its sentinel.
The provenance contains exact commands, versions, hashes, and receipt locations.

The fixture has 193 cases, 523 snapshots, 330 calls, and 663,481 rows.
Its fixed ledger precedes Rust replay:

| Disposition | Rows |
| --- | ---: |
| Derived observations compared with Rust | 535,591 |
| Supplied input genotype observations | 85,700 |
| Java World/VisibleWorld collaborator fields | 3,138 |
| Callback selection metadata | 193 |
| Inputs, schemas, and commands | 38,859 |

Each snapshot includes all 154 organism fields for three actors, genotype identities, and complete genotype observations.
It also includes ten World observations, 52 statistics fields, 49 getters, and a copied RNG suffix.
Only the five previously declared geometry allowances remain active.
The collaborator exclusions do not claim Rust UI integration.

Cases cover all 64 named colors, unknown and translucent colors, and all 36 copied reaction channels.
They cover single-segment and whole-body mimicry, colony coefficients, repeated contacts, methane support, and symbiosis.
Friendly cases cover kinship, altruism, peaceful transfers, healing order, infection identity, and lavender integer wrapping.
Controlled partial oxygen payments preserve changes made before later payments fail.

The first 178 cases passed Rust replay before the numerical extension.
Those original bytes remain a prefix of the final fixture.
The archived helper, fixture, and provenance remain under the original producer directory.
Fifteen appended cases cover raw coefficient boundaries, including NaN and signed zero.
The DarkGray NaN case fails before the production predicate correction and passes afterward.
The failed receipt and mismatch remain preserved.

This evidence covers the named methods only.
Physical contact scheduling, offensive color effects, complete organism frames, networking, and UI remain separate gates.
